Rectangle (आयत )
It is a quadrilateral, in which the opposite
sides are equal & parallel to each other. And
all the four vertex angles are equal to 90°.
(a) AB = DC = 𝒍 and BC = AD = 𝒃
(b) The diagonals bisect each other, but not
at right angles.
Diagonals AC = BD = √𝒍𝟐 + 𝒃𝟐
OA= 𝒅𝒊𝒂𝒈 = √𝒍𝟐+𝑏𝟐
(c) Perimeter = 𝟐(𝒍𝒆𝒏𝒈𝒕𝒉 + 𝒃𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅𝒕𝒉) = 𝟐(𝒍 + 𝒃)
(d) Area = 𝑳𝒆𝒏𝒈𝒕𝒉 × 𝑩𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅𝒕𝒉 = 𝒍 × 𝒃
